title: Preventive Maintenance and Trend Analysis
summary: Use trends and records to plan safe maintenance awareness and escalation.
objectives: Distinguish preventive maintenance from corrective repair.
Use trends and documentation to identify follow-up needs.

vocab.def: Planned work intended to reduce failure risk.
Work intended to restore a fault after it occurs.
A planned period for authorized maintenance activity.

sections.heading: Prevent before failure
sections.body: Inspection records, trend review, documentation checks, and planned maintenance windows can help teams manage risk. Students do not perform industrial service.

sections.heading: Professional boundary
sections.body: Filter, fan, compressor, pump, chiller, refrigerant, electrical, and controls work belongs to qualified professionals. Students may identify evidence and recommend escalation.

practice.prompt: A trend shows recurring temperature warnings. What can a student produce?
practice.answer: A factual trend summary with evidence and a recommendation for authorized follow-up.

lab.objective: Plan documented follow-up for a synthetic trend.

reflectionPrompt: What uncertainty should remain visible in a maintenance note?
